title: Heavenly Indian Tuna Rajma Jhol
description: A resinous, flaky, and nostalgic Indian dish featuring tuna, made with binchotan charcoal for a unique flavor and aroma, and using low-glycemic-friendly Rajma.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan charcoal grill to medium-high heat.
Season the tuna steaks with salt and set aside.
Grill the tuna steaks for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, heat the ghee in a pan over medium heat.
Add the Rajma and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the turmeric, red chili powder, and cumin powder to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Add the lemon juice to the pan and stir for another minute.
Once the tuna is cooked, place it on a plate and top with the Rajma mixture.
Garnish with chopped fresh coriander and serve immediately.
Serve with a side of steaming hot basmati rice or with naan bread.
Enjoy your delicious and healthy Tuna Rajma Jhol!
